run_calc_gt_masks: run the script to calculate ground-truth object masks and visibility masks for a BOP dataset
create_renderer_depth: create a depth renderer using vispy, cpp, or python backend for rendering 3D object models
render_object_pose: render an object model at a given camera pose to produce a synthetic depth image
estimate_visib_mask_gt: estimate the visible portion of an object silhouette by comparing rendered and captured depth images
convert_depth_to_dist: convert a depth image to a distance image using camera intrinsics for visibility comparison
